title: Linearity and Time-Variance Analysis of a Sample-and-Hold System
expert_review: A critical problem for students to understand why sampling processes, though linear, break the time-invariance assumption of LTI theory.
learning_objectives: Verify the linearity of a piecewise constant system
Explain why fixed-interval sampling leads to time-variance
Define the operational stages of a sample-and-hold circuit
Relate theoretical sampling to real-world ADC hardware
